description: Source collections served by one dispatcher each (issue #2451; runtime functions/src/platform/dispatch/runtime.ts). Each source names the document path its trigger watches and the area whose functions.ts re-exports dispatch<Source>, which decides its deploy codebase. tool/architecture/generate_dispatch_registries.mjs writes functions/src/<area>/dispatch/<source>.generated.ts from the defineProjections sets that name the source; --check fails when a registry is stale or not re-exported.
